subject.title: fix(tools): surface empty availability group diagnostics via onHiddenDiagnostic callback

question: After the auth-provider collector guard is fixed, should this PR be the canonical implementation for the linked availability-diagnostic bug, with warn-only preservation of plugin-authored availability-like metadata?
rationale: The code blocker is mechanical, but accepting preserved availability-like metadata and choosing among overlapping sibling PRs is a maintainer compatibility/canonical-path decision.

options.title: Fix and keep this PR canonical
options.body: Add the string guard, keep the warn-only descriptor diagnostic behavior, and review this PR as the landing candidate for the linked issue.

options.title: Choose a narrower sibling
options.body: Close or pause this PR after selecting another open linked PR as the canonical implementation for the same bug.

options.title: Defer the compatibility change
options.body: Leave the linked issue open until maintainers decide whether plugin-authored availability metadata should be preserved at all.

recommendation.title: Fix and keep this PR canonical
recommendation.body: Add the string guard, keep the warn-only descriptor diagnostic behavior, and review this PR as the landing candidate for the linked issue.
